authorization: User explicitly authorized medium simulations on 2026-10-23; language/writing assessment, literature-based size and applied-paper outputs prioritized. Separate new cohort; no append to old frozen G3 or small pilot.

generating_model.rater: first five delta/2; last five -delta/2; positive eta sign
generating_model.missingness: deterministic assignment independent of responses and theta
generating_model.local_independence: conditional on shared person theta; no script/criterion dependence

assignment.weak_bridge: h=p//2; block=p%2; a=h%5; b=(a+1)%5; bridge=h%10==(h//10)%5; [5*block+a, 5*(1-block if bridge else block)+b]
assignment.checks: identical 6*N rows and identical per-rater workload between designs; weak design exactly 10% cross-block persons; all persons complete all tasks with assigned pair

estimator.start: input-only zero facets and centered steps [-1,0,1]; independently cold for each q
estimator.retry: none; both stages mandatory for every returned finite point
estimator.covariance: invert structural information block with logSD excluded BEFORE inversion; no ridge/pseudoinverse

finite_numerical_limits.require: both optimizer stages successful; finite point; no certified structural recession/rank failure; unregularized SPD structural information

targets.primary: mean first five rater leniencies - mean last five; truth delta
targets.intervals: nominal 95% normal Wald full covariance; ignored-covariance comparator explicitly invalid approximation for contrasts
targets.decision: 95% interval excludes zero; prespecified exploratory contrast, not individual rater judgement

aggregation.coverage: among eligible finite-GH fits, never call continuous-target qualification
aggregation.mcse: independent datasets as unit; p MCSE sqrt(p*(1-p)/eligible), Wilson95% interval reported; bias SD/sqrt(eligible)
aggregation.unresolved: planned-denominator worst/best bounds [covered/planned,(covered+unresolved)/planned], NOT confidence intervals
aggregation.q_comparison: paired differences in estimate/SE/decision across common eligible datasets; lower order not assumed reference
aggregation.formal_release: no app inference hold is lifted by this study

matched_benchmark.same_work: same prepared data, cold start, q, solver, structural information and final score moments. Retain construction and total elapsed separately; no external engine speed ranking
matched_benchmark.performance_target: at least 20% median fit-time reduction at all matched checks passing; record all timings, failures and ranges; no p95 claim

continuous_reference.cases: rep0 each of 8 cells at q81 returned point, no outcome selection
continuous_reference.refinement: all four N200 rep0 cases at bound14 rel1e-12 abs1e-14
continuous_reference.limitation: Subset checks do not certify every replicate; no automatic q replacement or selected rerun

tam.version: 4.3.25 to be verified in runtime record
tam.compare: mapped logits/coordinates and common continuous likelihood; native diagonal SE not gold standard; no engine speed ranking

resource_limits.failure_policy: record exceptions/timeouts/unrun planned rows; never silently drop, loosen thresholds or replace seed

literature.role: Kikuhara2025:97Japanese high school writers,3tasks,3raters,4analytic criteria,6categories with4category reanalysis; motivates tasks/categories, not numerical parameter truth or recommendation to collapse categories
Wind and Ge2021 sparse-design study: N200/500/1000,20:1students/raters; motivates sample sizes. R10 retained across N to separate sample size; N500 is not exact replication
Morris, White and Crowther2019: ADEMP and MonteCarlo uncertainty

limits: Exploratory 24rep/cell: nominal95%coverage MCSE about4.45 percentage points before failures; max10.21pp atp.5. No general evidence of 95%coverage. RSM,fixedcorrect N01,oneconstruct,unitweights,balancedtasks; excludes freeSD/PCM/GPCM/anchors/localdependence/misspecifiedability/raterdrift.
